answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to post a stake that is slashed on proven misbehavior, turning identity creation into a bridge that costs real capital to cross. Reputation then accrues slowly, like saffron gathered petal by petal, so a fresh swarm of clones starts with ivory-clean but empty histories and cannot outvote established agents. Attackers must fund every fake identity, making large-scale forgery economically irrational.
